Guidance for Claude Code (claude.ai/code): enterprise cross-platform dotfiles repository (macOS, Linux, WSL; tiered shell, tmux, Neovim; CI/CD agent mode).

Commands:
./install.sh install standard
./install.sh install minimal     # Essential tools only
./install.sh install full        # Complete setup with AI tools
./install.sh install ai_focused  # AI-enhanced development
./install.sh --dry-run install standard
./install.sh link
dot setup
dot check
dot update
dot reload
dot project init
dot ai review
dot security scan
dot metrics dashboard
dot plugin list
dot migrate status
./tests/test_runner.sh
dot test quick
./tests/test_runner.sh --category infrastructure
find . -name "*.sh" -exec shellcheck {} \;
find . -name "*.yaml" -o -name "*.yml" | xargs yamllint
dot check                    # Full system health check
dot doctor                   # Diagnose issues
dot test run                 # Run all tests
perf-status                  # Check performance
perf-bench                   # Run benchmarks
perf-quick                   # One-command optimization

Layout: `bin/` CLI/utilities; `config/` templates/configs; `lib/` libraries; `plugins/`; `scripts/`; `tests/`. `bin/dot` orchestrates `lib/cli/`: `core.sh`, `ai.sh`, `security.sh`, `project.sh`, `testing.sh`.

Tools: `config/tools.yaml`; profiles minimal, standard, full, ai_focused;
